info.title: Rochell Core API
info.description: Vertical Slice #1 (Frozen Baseline v2.1.1). Decimal values are JSON strings (ADR-015).

get.summary: The signed-in user, session expiry, step-up freshness and roles per company.
Starts the Google Workspace sign-in (browser navigation).
Re-authenticates the current user (prompt=login) before an action that requires it.
Synthetic users the signed-in person may act as in a company (needs identity:act_as; TEST databases only).

post.summary: Acts as a synthetic user (E-B03-14): segregation of duties and four-eyes rules apply to it as to anyone.
Returns to the signed-in person's own session.
